Title:Sparse Mixtures for Long Context

Authors:Jane Doe, Richard Roe
Abstract:We study sparse mixtures of experts for long-context language modelling. Routing tokens by position, rather than by content, cuts memory use by a third, keeps quality within one point, and simplifies training. We release code, checkpoints, and evaluation scripts.
